name: sajha_planner_routing_propose
title: Propose planner routing rules from results
description:
Ranks planners per tool and question class from saved eval runs and recorded outcomes of automatic planner choices, and writes a proposal that takes effect only when an administrator approves it on the Planner routing page; administrators only.
Returns {id, status, hash, changes, evidence: {eval_outcomes, run_outcomes, tools}, rules}; with dry_run true nothing is written and id is empty.
Inputs (none required): dry_run (boolean, default false).
Example: {"dry_run": true}
Run on a schedule by the shipped planner_routing_learn workflow (its trigger is off until enabled).

dry_run.description: Rank and return the rules without writing a proposal
